quests.title: First Steps
quests.text: Climb the pillars behind the plaza and stand on the summit stone.

quests.title: Scavenger
quests.text: Crack open three loot crates out in the field.

quests.title: Pocket Money
quests.text: Bank fifty coins, by whatever means.

quests.title: The Hermit's Errand
quests.text: Find the hollow at the far edge of the field.
